cards.title: Model Parameterization and Structural Assumptions
cards.claim: PK models can be parameterized via Micro (mass transfer rate constants), Clearance (clearance-based differential equations), or Macro (closed-form sum of exponentials). Macro models require a 'stripping dose' assumption to scale predictions to different doses. Saturable elimination requires Km and Vmax parameters.
conditions: Selection of parameterization affects which parameters are primary vs. derived.
Macro models assume a fixed reference dose for scaling.
required_inputs: Choice of parameterization method (Micro, Clearance, Macro).
limitations: Macro models do not directly model volume; it is derived.
Incorrect parameterization can lead to misinterpretation of Vss vs Vc.
cards.downstream_use: Determines the mathematical structure of the simulation engine and the interpretation of fitted parameters.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
